purpose: Construct site-centered breeding-option traits for the frozen Antarctic Pygoscelis candidate sample without requiring literal island-polygon assignment.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: Population trend direction, abundance change, extinction, colonization, replacement and any fitted demographic response remain unopened.

ecosystem_inventory.dataset: Antarctic Ecosystem Inventory: Spatial data for Ice-free lands v1.0
ecosystem_inventory.interpretation: Valid raster cells are mapped ice-free ecosystem cells; background/nodata is not interpreted as suitable habitat.

spatial_scales.reason: Two kilometres is frozen as the local breeding-option scale before demographic outcomes are opened; smaller/larger radii are retained only as spatial-scale sensitivities.

coverage_gate.rule: At least 90% of the 122 candidate APBP sites must contain one or more mapped ice-free ecosystem pixels within the predeclared 2 km primary radius.

boundary: Mapped ice-free area is not assumed to equal occupied nesting area.
Ecosystem-class diversity is a breeding-option proxy, not a demonstrated causal mechanism.
Literal offshore-island/mainland classification and total island area remain a secondary geometry lane.
No trait is selected or removed based on association with penguin demography at this gate.

next_gate_only_if_passed.name: Gate 1D terrain and melt augmentation
next_gate_only_if_passed.rule: Add topographic and melt traits using the same frozen candidate sites and primary 2 km scale before demographic outcomes are opened.
